response.text: {"summary":"The tcp_chat repository implements a simple TCP‑based chat system. The command‑line client in client.py connects to the server and communicates using the line protocol defined in protocol.py (path::protocol.py::parse_message). The server in server.py runs a threaded TCP chat server that assigns each client a unique nickname and broadcasts incoming messages to all connected clients (path::server.py::handle_client). Together, the client, server, and protocol modules provide a complete chat application that can be exercised with pytest tests."}
